title: fix: 20+ stability fixes for router/low-memory deployments
head: yangw9182-del:pr/stability-fixes
body:
## Summary
A set of stability fixes validated on a 128MB OpenWrt router (DSG-AX3000/IPQ5018) running as a transparent proxy for 30+ days without crash.

## Fixes included

### Crash / panic hardening
- `redir`/`tproxy`/`must_into_socket_addr`: replace `unwrap()` with error-tolerant handling — no more panic on malformed connections
- `network_listener`: all inbounds (http/socks/mixed/redir/tproxy/tunnel) keep listening after accept errors
- `dispatcher`: harden `expect()` calls

### Concurrency
- `statistics_manager`: fix lock held across await (deadlock)
- `HealthCheck`: add `Drop` + `stopped` flag to stop background task on hot-reload (prevents task leak)
- copy buffer yield — avoids CPU starvation at high throughput

### Stability
- `session.rs`: clamp domain to 255 bytes, harden match guard
- `urltest`: backoff + tolerance support + proper force-switch behavior
- shadowsocks/anytls outbound: timeout & decode fixes

### Memory
The memory-leak after speed test is fixed with configurable buffers.

## Test
- Device: DSG-AX3000 (IPQ5018, 128MB RAM, OpenWrt 19.07)
- Mode: transparent proxy (redir 7892 + tproxy 7893) + fake-ip DNS
- Result: continuous 30+ days, no crash, RSS stable at ~17MB

## Note
Additive env vars (`CLASH_RS_MEM_LIMIT_MB`, `CLASH_RS_HEALTHCHECK_CONCURRENCY`) are off by default, safe to merge.
